message.content:
Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most acclaimed crime‑thrillers released (or widely available) in 2020, along with a short note on why they stood out:

| # | Title | Director | Why It Shines |
|---|-------|----------|---------------|
| 1 | **Tenet** | Christopher Nolan | A mind‑bending time‑travel heist that blends high‑concept sci‑fi with gritty espionage. |
| 2 | **The Gentlemen** | Guy Ritchie | Ritchie's signature fast‑paced style meets a sharp, witty take on the British drug trade. |
| 3 | **Uncut Gems** | Josh & Benny Safdie | Adam Sandler turns into a manic jeweler‑turned‑criminal; the film’s frantic pacing keeps you glued. |
| 4 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Scorsese’s epic saga of mob life, featuring an all‑star cast and groundbreaking de-aging tech. |
| 5 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Though more courtroom drama than traditional thriller, its tense narrative and powerful performances make it a gripping watch. |
| 6 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | A Danish psychological thriller about a man falsely accused of child abuse; it’s unsettling and thought‑provoking. |
| 7 | **The Invisible Man** | Leigh Whannell | A modern retelling of the classic horror story, but with a strong feminist angle and suspenseful twists. |
| 8 | **The Night House** | David Bruckner | A chilling blend of supernatural mystery and domestic drama that keeps you guessing until the end. |
| 9 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | A historical crime‑drama that uses medieval justice as a backdrop for a tense duel of truth vs. lies. |
|10 | **Mortal Kombat** | Simon McQuoid | While primarily a fantasy action movie, its plot centers around a deadly tournament that feels like a crime‑thriller in disguise. |

> **Quick Tips for Watching:**  
> • If you’re looking for pure tension, start with *Uncut Gems* or *The Hunt*.  
> • For a mix of humor and crime, *The Gentlemen* is a great pick.  
> • If you prefer a long‑form, character‑driven story, give *The Irishman* a try.

Enjoy your binge‑watch!
